# APP_62_Workflow_HumanInTheLoopManager

A service that manages exceptions and escalations in automated workflows, routing tasks to human operators for review and approval when AI confidence is low.

## Problem Statement

Automated AI workflows, while highly efficient for routine tasks, frequently encounter edge cases, ambiguous inputs, or low-confidence predictions that necessitate human judgment. Without a robust and auditable mechanism to handle these exceptions, automated processes can fail silently, produce incorrect outputs, or get stuck in an indeterminate state. This leads to operational bottlenecks, compliance risks, financial losses, and a significant erosion of trust in AI systems. Existing solutions are often ad-hoc, lack proper audit trails, or are poorly integrated with modern AI orchestration layers, making it difficult to scale and manage human oversight effectively.
